venue.name: Multiple Cities
venue.details: See the locations tab for more information about venue locations

information: The competition will be held in multiple locations, across the globe. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your location! Locations may be added until **May 17th 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates). For all locations with a field labelled TBD, registrations will be accepted in the order they were submitted in after the location is finalised.
